decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 19th May 2006, the erection of a ground floor side extension, with dimensions 1.80 metres wide, 5.62 metres deep, and 2.75 metres high, and a roof light with 0.90 metres wide, 2.50 metres deep and 0.30 metres high, returning a volume of 28.50m3, giving a total volume increase to the original house of 49.61m3, as shown on drawing numbers WHG/A100 & WHG/A101, received 19th May 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of the erection of a ground floor side extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of single storey rear infill extension to house
